title: Hinomori Shiho — Happy Birthday! 2026〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: A Cafe

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I was right, it is a letter.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, you already found it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? Hold on, is this yours?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. I didn't know where to hide it, and thought you'd miss it if it was somewhere obvious... Hahaha, I guess it backfired.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I guess it was a little ambitious.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So the treasures...are letters from everyone?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! We all wrote letters to you. Make sure to find all of them!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, the design on this envelope is very you, Kohane. Can I read this now?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... It's a little embarrassing, but it is for you. Please go ahead.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay. Here goes...

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Letter
rows.Line: <To Shiho. Happy birthday! Thank you for chatting with me a lot during our first year!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Letter
rows.Line: <I'm really glad that we got to be in the same class last year and were able to become close friends. I hope we have more fun times together from here onward.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hehe, sounds exactly like you, Kohane. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehehe. Mine wasn't hidden for long, but I'm glad you liked it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There's plenty more where that came from. Do keep searching.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right. Okay, where next. Ah, looks like there's something on the back of that balloon...
se_walk_women_004_1

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I knew it, it's an envelope.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm, there's a drawing on it. I'm guessing this is Honami's?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Looks like you found me out... I did my best to draw your bass.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you. I really like the drawing. I'm gonna read the letter now.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Letter
rows.Line: <To Shiho. Thank you for giving us the push we needed. I wouldn't be where I am today if you weren't there to inspire me to be on your level.>

rows.Speaker: Honami's Letter
rows.Line: <I've always admired your straightforward attitude. I'll make sure to become a leader worthy of all of you. Thank you for everything.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I should be the one thanking you for everything. Thanks for always getting us into gear.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No problem! Looking forward to more memories with you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was a little nervous... But it does feel nice to have you read my letter with my honest feelings.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Writing it was sort of intimidating since you have such neat handwriting, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Really? You know I don't care about that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Okay, already got two down. So far, so good.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Hope the other ones are easy to find.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ah, found another one. It was hiding behind the decoration.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But why is this envelope so thick?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: <Shiho! Happy birthday!!!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Whoa! Was that...Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa actually came a little before you arrived to hide his letter.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe, Tsukasa's letter came with a surprise! The speaker plays when you open the envelope☆

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I-I see. That's kind of amazing...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line:
<Shiho! Happy birthday!!!>
<...Shiho! Happy birthday!!!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's so loud that it's distracting me from actually reading the letter...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I've been meaning to ask... That box in the middle is a gift, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, uh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Now that I'm actually looking at it, there's a letter on there. Did you even bother trying to hide it?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Can I open it?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, it is practically screaming “open me!” given its location...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, I'm opening it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Oh, it's a sweatshirt. It's an understated design, and it'd match a lot of stuff.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Hm... This embroidery, though...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This gift is from you, right? Thank you for the embroidery.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's right! It makes me happy that you can tell just from looking at it...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ah! You found mine!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's amazing, Shiho! How are you finding them so fast?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm pretty sure we all wanted her to find them, which is why we didn't make it too difficult, but even so...she's very fast.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yup. Although, Shizuku's might've been too easy.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright. I think the only ones left are from Momoi, Kiritani and Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Don't think we've made it a walk in the park for you. We definitely put ours in places you would never expect. Right, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sure did! Hope you're prepared, Hinomori!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Really? We'll see about that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: After coming this far, I'm not giving up. I'll be sure to keep searching.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright. That'd make this last letter from Kiritani. Which means, mission complete.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Aw... I guess you found it in the end. I sneakily hid it in your bag during the party, but I didn't expect you to figure that one out.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Same here! I was so sure that she would never be able to find yours!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I didn't have any luck anywhere else, so I had a suspicion. I'm glad I was right.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: More importantly...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: These are a lot of letters...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's like a mountain! You were so cool finding them all one after another, Shiho! You were like a detective♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, it was pretty fun actually.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm going to treasure all of these. Thank you for planning all of this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Of course! All we wanted was to just make sure you smile!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes! But the party has only just started. Hope you have a fun time, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I know, I know. I'm looking forward to it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Shii! It really did make me happy when you realized the sweatshirt was from me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I know you're working hard as a pro now, but let's go somewhere together again for a break sometime.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Shiho. I was so confident that you weren't going to find my letter! But that frustration was gone as soon as I saw your face when reading it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I feel the same way. We could see that you read them all with such care. Thank you for accepting our messages, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Shiho! Spending time like this together kind of takes me back to when we were first-years! It was so much fun! Let's go hang out again sometime with Kohane, the three of us!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I want to go hang out somewhere with you too, Shiho. I know you're busy with being a pro but let's definitely do it sometime. Hope you have an amazing rest of your day!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Shiho! I did a lot of thinking of what to write in my letter to you, so I hope it'll be a letter you can read over and over again☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I heard that you took the time to read my letter as well. Do let me know if the speaker's battery runs out, as I'll be sure to swap it with new ones. It came with a lifetime's warranty after all!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Hinomori. Um, my letter is just a regular one, but... I've written down how to turn off the speaker. So please read it when you have the time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Once again, happy birthday, Hinomori! If you ever have some time, do come by Vivid Street again! It'll be so much fun getting to watch a show together!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I heard from Otori about your birthday party. Sounds like you all had a fun time. Happy birthday, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Shiho! Saki told us about the plans, so we also wrote letters too. Right, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I was wondering what was with the sudden request for an illustration, but when I found out it was a gift for you, I made sure to pull out all the stops. I hope you like it, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Shiho. We wanted to see you smiling like you did when you were reading the fan letters, and I guess our plan was a success.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's keep doing our best as Leo/need from here on out. Let's keep improving so more people can come to know us, all so we can reach their hearts with our music.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Looks like our feelings also reached Shiho through our letters. Teehee♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It made me happy that you enjoyed the party♪ Happy birthday again! Let's keep performing and making music together!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Shiho. It was a little intimidating expressing my feelings through a letter, but I'm glad you liked it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We've got practices, shows and recordings, but let's keep doing our best for all of them! I hope you had an amazing birthday today!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you for all the birthday wishes.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I had a really fun time today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I realized once again just how many people care about me...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: To make sure that I return that sentiment...I'll be sure to give my best performance.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, I hope you stick around.
